task: Remove structural BRL fallback from global Home item discovery
coordination: Read README, readiness, revenue-scorecard and this agent state before editing.
cutinapp-launch-tickets owns the P0 exactly-once payment/ticket issuance work and was not duplicated.

No subscription price, automatic billing, entitlement or ticket commission behavior was introduced.
problem: HomeHubPage formatted every discovered production item with pt-BR/BRL regardless of the event, item or production currency. This was a structural Brazil/BRL fallback on a worldwide discovery surface.
impact: Showing the wrong currency damages participant trust and producer value perception outside Brazil, constraining global activation and the usage that must precede producer subscription conversion/retention.
solution: Removed the fixed pt-BR/BRL formatter. Item cards now resolve currency dynamically from item, event or production metadata and use the browser locale. When valid currency metadata is absent, the UI renders a neutral localized number rather than inventing BRL or another currency.
evidence: Before commit ebb4b2b498376d0a1125a543342615555c0954d9, src/pages/HomeHubPage.js declared Intl.NumberFormat('pt-BR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'BRL' }) and used it for all discovered item prices.
Commit ebb4b2b498376d0a1125a543342615555c0954d9 removes that fixed formatter and derives currency from item.currency/item.currency_code, event currency metadata, or production currency metadata.

risk: Low-to-medium. Display formatting only; no checkout amount, payment, auth, publication, entitlement or persisted financial data changed.
